series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. DS-02: Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID, 2015-2025. DS-40: Total GHG emissions including LULUCF/LUCF exactly as the Party submitted them to the UNFCCC, on that Party’s own reporting guidelines and GWP set (UNFCCC Data Interface, snapshot of 2024-07-05). Non-Annex I Parties report only the years their national communications cover, and the figure is negative where reported removals exceed reported emissions. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

derived.$note: Trend: least-squares slope over 35 observed years (1990-2024) from DS-35, compared against the DS-06-NDC-LATEST target of 148.971 MtCO₂e by 2035. The two are not necessarily on the same inventory scope, see series.$note. The target tonnage is derived here, not quoted: 81% below DS-35's 1990 value of 784.056 MtCO₂e. The document states the percentage; the level it is applied to comes from DS-35, on DS-35's inventory scope, which is not necessarily the document's.

title.text: 4. Structured summary: Tracking progress made in implementing and achieving the NDC under Article 4 of the Paris Agreement a

label.text: Total net GHG emissions and removals

progress.text:
In 2022, total net GHG emissions and removals were 50% below the base year.

For the UK NDC to be achieved, total net GHG emissions and removals need to be at least 68% below the base year in 2030.

target_text.text:
Economy-wide absolute emission reduction.
An at least 68% reduction in total net GHG emissions and removals in 2030 compared to the base year.

reference_text.text:
Current base year estimate: 817.1 MtCO2e.
The base year is 1990 for CO2, CH4 and N2O and 1995 for HFCs, PFCs, SF6 and NF3.
The current base year estimate is based on the UK NIR submitted to the UNFCCC in 2024. The estimate is subject to change in future UK NIRs.

verdict.text: United Kingdom pledges an 81% reduction by 2035 against 1990 baseline (condition not read). The registry's current submission for this Party is The UK’s 2035 NDC ICTU, filed 2025-01-30. 78 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (32). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 436.2 MtCO₂e, DS-35 390.3 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. The target is not reached on the observed trend: it would need cuts 1.783× faster. Both figures are on DS-35's inventory: the document's percentage applied to DS-35's 1990 level, not the document's own. It submitted BTR1. 5 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 68.6 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: The European Union and its 28 Member States submitted a joint NDC: at least 40% domestic reduction in GHG emissions by 2030 compared to 1990 It was classed unconditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +0.84°C under SSP1-2.6 to +3.1°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
